status: Staged fact sheet for PSPMAN 0.1.0-alpha.3 User's Guide

identity.creator: ObsoleteSony
identity.description: Walkman-inspired FLAC and MP3 music player for Sony PSP, built with PocketJS.
identity.sourceAvailability: Private-source during active development; source code is not included with the Public Alpha

installation.storage: Memory Stick; PSP Go requires Memory Stick Micro (M2)
installation.pspGoInternalStorage: Not supported in this Public Alpha

supportedModels: PSP Go with Memory Stick Micro (M2)
hardware.softwareRequirement: Custom firmware or another working homebrew environment

audio.supported: stereo 16-bit / 44.1 kHz FLAC; MPEG-1 Layer III MP3 at 44.1 kHz, CBR or VBR, mono or stereo, through 320 kbps

metadata.flac: Vorbis comments and embedded PICTURE front cover
metadata.mp3: ID3 title, artist, album, track, and disc fields with embedded APIC JPEG or PNG front cover
metadata.display: UTF-8 metadata is preserved; some Japanese characters may not display correctly

artwork.behavior: Under memory pressure, some embedded artwork may not load; playback is unaffected and images that cannot be displayed show No Cover
artwork.guidance: Embedded JPEG or PNG; use smaller JPEG artwork as a temporary workaround when PNG or unusually large artwork does not display

library.startup: recursively scans enabled storage roots and reuses the persisted library index

about: SELECT opens the global About overlay; any button closes it
diagnostics: Pause playback, return to Library, then hold TRIANGLE to open Diagnostics
quit: HOME opens the PSP system confirmation; a confirmed exit completes PSPMAN's clean shutdown path
